item.artDescription: This weapon is engraved with a representation of three weavers and tailors eating pumpkins together. The work is executed in a sinuous style. Strikingly, at the edge of the image are eight triangles.

An engraving on this weapon illustrates Jordan 'Biologist' Malish touching down in a drop pod in front of an oasis. He is unconscious, his tongue lolling out, drool dripping. The work is infused with the idea of thought and is done in an abstract style. In addition to that, at the edge of the image are three fiends. This illustration tells the story of Biologist's landing in a drop pod on 6th of Aprimay, 5500.

This weapon bears a depiction of an army attacking two blacksmiths. Chef wields a rifle defensively while flexing her muscles. The triangular structure of the image almost conflicts with its neoclassical style. The lower part of the image is dominated by thousands of toads. This image relates to an raid on Chef's hamlet on 7th of Aprimay, 5500.
An engraving on this weapon illustrates a stone. There is an acrobat in the distance. The overall composition is triangular.
